def apply_orth(alpha, attn_o=True, linear_out=False, down=False):
    names = []
    if attn_o:
        names += [f'model.language_model.layers.{L}.self_attn.o_proj.weight' for L in ATTN]
    if linear_out:
        names += [f'model.language_model.layers.{L}.linear_attn.out_proj.weight' for L in ALL_L if L not in ATTN]
    if down:
        names += [f'model.language_model.layers.{L}.mlp.down_proj.weight' for L in ALL_L]
    for name in names:
        W = load_original(name).float()   # [out, in]
        dW = d_t @ W                        # [in]
        W2 = W + alpha * torch.outer(d_t, dW)
        save_edit(name, W2.float())
    return names

rM = (emb[np.array(freq_ids)] * r1p[None, :]).T  # 1024 x 200
# remove projection of rThink onto span(rM)

beta, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(rM.T @ rM + 1e-6*np.eye(len(freq_ids)), rM.T @ rT, rcond=None)
d_spec = rT - rM @ beta
print('|rT|', np.linalg.norm(rT), '|d_spec|', np.linalg.norm(d_spec))
np.save('/work/d_spec.npy', (d_spec/np.linalg.norm(d_spec)).astype(np.float32))
